Route 9


TrainersPokemonItems


Wild Area?: No
North Exit: Circhester
East Exit: Spikemuth
West Exit: Route 9 Tunnel

Route 9 is a long route that is separated into three areas. The first area is in the north and crosses through a river.

Circhester Bay
Circhester Bay is the largest part of the Route and requires traversal using the Rotom Bike. It's a mixture of coastal islands connected with and blocked by various icerbergs

Outer Spikemuth
Outer Spikemuth is a small area outside the town of Spikemuth. It is a cliffside area which features various marine Pokémon.
